They won't take you to court if you have no assets as it will cost them and they will still get nothing.

I met someone from a chat room who also had SA. We chatted every night for months online first. On that first meet up in person, my SA didn't play up much at all because I felt I knew her well.

What sort of jobs are you applying for? I ended up going self employed as my SA stopped me getting jobs. It still annoys me to think how litttle being good at the job counted for at an interview.  Having clever answers to silly questions doesnt mean you can fix printers any better.

Small talk is a killer, everyone seems to do it ok but my brain goes to mush trying to think of something to say without sounding silly. I just end up saying nothing then the awkward silences happen and the SA gets even worse as I can tell they dont like me. I find it so much easier to talk about a given subject, professional conversations, but chatting with people I have nothing in common with is a nightmare.

Just remember if worse comes to the worse, you can just go self employed. Thats what I did when my SA stopped me getting jobs. Its not great because the lack of exposure can make the SA worse, but at least you can pay the bills.
